scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target bun --format esm --outdir dist --external sandbar-sdk --external @sandbar/adapter --external zod && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && cp -R ../store/migrations dist/migrations && if test -d ../../apps/web/dist; then cp -R ../../apps/web/dist dist/web; fi
